subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: Mahatma Gandhi was born in Gujrat, India. He studied law at University College, London. As he was too shy, he could not continue his practice in bar. In 1920, he took the leadership of Congress. He demanded immediate independence of India in 1942. Gandi was shot when he was going to address prayer meeting.
